text:
Elaine: Heads-up — found two issues in the ratecard/quotas docs: 1) the rate card table still talks about 'per-request' billing for embeddings (should be per-token). 2) the SDK snippet references the old `X-Rate-Limit` header (v1) and the grafana panel link at the bottom 404s. I opened a quick PR with fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8276 — can @Samir @Marta take a look?
Samir: On it. I'll update the SDK examples (python + ts) to show the new header `X-Usage-Tokens` and add a small note about burst credits. Will push a commit to the PR in ~30m.
Marta: I'll audit the dashboard link and panel name — looks like panel was renamed to `metered_tokens_total`. I'll patch the link+panel label. ETA end of day.
Elaine: Also: can we add a short migration note that explains v1 -> v3 header mapping so customers know backcompat?
Samir: Yep — adding a one-paragraph note at the top of the quota section. Also swapping the code snippet to use the SDK helper `client.get_usage()` in examples instead of raw headers. Example I'll add:
```python
# minimal: get usage tokens in Python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
usage = client.get_usage(start="2026-01-01", end="2026-02-01")
print(usage.tokens_used)
```
Marta: Quick FYI — the grafana link in the docs was pointing to the old team dashboard (internal team-only). I replaced it with the public metering dashboard URL and fixed panel id. Pushed tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8279
Ryan: I'll update the ratecard CSV and the example JSON used for the pricing table. Will add a note where we switched embeddings to per-token billing and add a sample calculation for a 1k-token embedding.
Elaine: Great. Let's coordinate merges so we don't conflict. Plan: wait for docs CI (link-check + examples smoke) then merge Samir->Marta->Ryan sequence. @DocsBot can you run link-check + examples-smoke when builds free?
DocsBot: scheduled: link-check + examples-smoke (python + ts) queued for PRs 8276, 8279. Automated lint passed on PR 8276 but link-check flagged 12 external 404s earlier — re-check after Marta's PR.
Samir: Pushed the python + ts snippet changes to 8276 and added the migration note. Also inserted a small code comment about `burst_credits` behavior. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8276#discussion_r1234567
Marta: Link PR 8279 merged (grafana link + panel rename). Ran local linkcheck, looks clean.
DocsBot: info: link-check on 8276 re-run queued.
Elaine: Once link-check is green, I'll merge 8276 then Ryan's CSV PR. Ryan — can you rebase onto main after 8276 merges?
Ryan: Yep, will rebase and run the pricing unit tests.
Samir: Note for reviewers — I changed the SDK snippet to prefer `client.get_usage()` which uses the server-side aggregation; kept the raw header example below it for advanced users.
Marta: :thumbsup:
Elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll update the changelog entry and add a short 'what changed' blurb on the top of the rate-limits page so support has something to paste. If anything blocks merge, ping here.
DocsBot: completed: link-check + examples-smoke queued, awaiting CI.
